title: Normalizers of the congruence subgroups Γ_H
summary: Formal statements and proofs, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, about the normalizers in SL₂(ℝ) of every congruence subgroup Γ ⊇ Γ(N), that is, of every Γ_H for H ≤ SL₂(ℤ/N): Nor(Γ)/Γ is finite, of order at most [SL₂(ℤ) : Γ]·Σ_{D ∣ N} ψ(D); the local restrictions of Dose–Lido–Mercuri on the determinants of normalizing matrices; if, at every p ∣ N, H mod p fixes no line or H mod p^{v_p(N)} lies in a split Cartan subgroup, then Nor(Γ_H)/Γ_H ≅ N(H)/H; and at prime level the order is always [N(H) : H], or 2·[N(H) : H] when H fixes exactly one line. 21 theorems, no sorry, only the axioms propext,…

review.reason: Lean 4 formal results on normalizers of congruence subgroups in SL2(R).
